claire: opened PR 978 to update the Console observability quickstart. Scope: replace old tracing-hook links, update dashboard YAML to new metric names, add a tiny Ruby SDK snippet for trace attach + cost tag, and a compact p50/p95 cost table.

ben: thanks. can we prefer a minimal dashboard YAML so users can copy-paste? also call out the metric rename in one line.

claire: yes minimal only + a single migration note. docs-bot: lint: docs/obs_quickstart.md -> broken link https://old.link/tracehook -> 404; image docs/images/heatmap_old.svg -> 404.

eli: I'll replace the image with new heatmap.png and add redirects for the dead tracehook URL.

ben: draft Ruby snippet (short):
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
ctx = client.new_trace_context('obs-quickstart')
ctx.set_tag('cost_center', 'backend') # used in dashboards for cost attribution
# tip: client.config.max_batch_tokens = 1024 to favor cost over p95
url = client.dashboards.render(ctx, 'compact')
puts url.share_url
```

claire: nice and compact. add a one-line explanation above the code about tuning MaxBatchTokens tradeoffs. Also ask infra to add a smoke test that validates frontmatter links return 200.
